mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals severe labor market weakness triggering policy intervention, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in housing starts indicates labor-demand contraction, triggering positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days as stimulus expectations rise.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE rising and HOUST falling fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Monetary accommodation (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) drives sustained S&P 500 outperformance over 60 trading days as low rates support economic recovery and equity valuations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 600,000 units signal residential sector weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic slowdown fears intensify.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 600.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth above 130,000,000 persons indicates robust labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 130.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in industrial production and housing starts signals broad economic weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO and HOUST declining fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
